description: This Java class defines a JPA entity for a notification queue system, including fields for email notifications such as recipient, subject, body, status, retry count, scheduling, and timestamps. It provides getter and setter methods for each property and uses annotations to map to a database table.

classes.name: NotificationQueue
classes.description: JPA entity representing an outbound notification queue with lifecycle management, including status, retries, scheduling, and timestamps.

classes.name: NotificationQueue.Status
classes.description: Enum representing the status of notifications: PENDING, SENT, FAILED.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the notification.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the current status of the notification.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the current status of the notification.

methods.name: getRetryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of retry attempts.

methods.name: getScheduledAt
methods.description: Returns the scheduled time for sending the notification.

methods.name: setScheduledAt
methods.description: Sets the scheduled time for the notification.

methods.name: getSentAt
methods.description: Returns the time the notification was sent.

methods.name: setSentAt
methods.description: Sets the time the notification was sent.
